product_brief: A modern, simple, and secure file encryption tool with native post-quantum resistance and plugin support.
pqc_capability_description: v1.3.0 introduces native post-quantum recipients based on HPKE with a hybrid ML-KEM-768 KEM. Recipients start with age1pq1... and identities with AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1... Supports hardware plugins for PQC.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM-768, X25519 (implied by hybrid recipient type "mlkem768x25519"), HPKE
key_management_model: Native keys, passphrase-encrypted identities, hardware plugin compatible (YubiKey, TPM, SE)
architecture_type: CLI tool with plugin framework; supports agentless file encryption
primary_platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS (implied by CLI/Go framework)
pqc_roadmap_details: v1.3.0 released with native PQC support using ML-KEM-768 hybrid KEM.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: age-inspect tool presents metadata of an age file without decrypting it, including recipient types and encryption overhead.
testing_&_validation_methods: C2SP has the specification, and CCTV has test vectors for the new hybrid recipient types.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Release artifacts include a source tarball with vendored dependencies.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Optional plugin available for older age clients to support encryption to hybrid recipients.
